query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: Extracts a review theme with well-separated, interpretable categories (attentive_warm, inattentive_rude, professional_neutral, robotic_mechanical) that can be segmented and compared against Overall Rating. This is a genuine associational variable derived from text, not a restatement of the numeric ratings.

per_column.name: food_quality
per_column.rationale: Ordinal, interpretable categories (excellent/acceptable/poor) drawn from review text. A meaningful theme to cross-tabulate against Overall Rating. Slightly overlaps with the existing 'Food & Beverages' rating but adds a text-derived thematic view, so still informative.

per_column.name: seat_cabin_hardware_condition
per_column.rationale: Clean, well-separated categories describing hardware condition (new_excellent, adequate_functional, dated_worn, broken_defective). A distinct review theme that can be grouped and compared against Overall Rating.

per_column.name: service_decline_signal
per_column.rationale: Binary flag with a reasonable split (571/329) capturing perceived decline. Interpretable and segmentable, though somewhat vaguely defined; still supports a meaningful comparison against Overall Rating.

per_column.name: value_for_money_perception
per_column.rationale: Interpretable ordinal categories. Note this closely parallels the existing 'Value For Money' column, so it partly restates an existing feature, but as a text-derived theme it remains a usable segmentation dimension.

per_column.name: disruption_handling_quality
per_column.rationale: Interpretable categories about how disruptions were handled. Heavily dominated by 'not_applicable' (696/900), so the informative categories are sparse, but where present they enable a meaningful comparison against Overall Rating.

per_column.name: family_child_accommodation
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag. Highly imbalanced (852/48 true), limiting comparison power, but still a distinct interpretable segment that could relate to rating for family travellers.

judge.rationale: The set consists of text-derived review themes with clean, interpretable, well-separated categorical levels that can each be grouped/segmented and cross-tabulated against Overall Rating across Type of Traveller and Class -- exactly the exploratory goal. Most columns (crew_service_quality, food_quality, seat_cabin_hardware_condition) have balanced, discriminating categories ideal for discovering relationships. Deductions: value_for_money_perception largely restates the existing Value For Money field; disruption_handling_quality and family_child_accommodation are so imbalanced (dominated by not_applicable/false) that comparisons rest on small subgroups, limiting their informativeness. Overall a strong, human-interpretable EDA set.
